response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg_bandwidth FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT sa.observstation, sa.station_avg_bandwidth, sa.station_avg_bandwidth - oa.avg_bandwidth as margin FROM station_avg sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.station_avg_bandwidth > oa.avg_bandwidth ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 10
